productDecision: Select Glukhar on Reserve as the command-grade HVT. The operation requires one command target, then a successful extraction; it does not admit follower farming, multi-boss ladders, trophy handovers or repeatable boss population control.
whyThisTarget: Glukhar is a literal command element with a coherent Reserve identity, so the objective matches Command Window rather than using an arbitrary boss for difficulty alone.
A single boss target preserves the source concept while compressing the legacy escalating boss/follower counters into one bounded operation.
Reserve already has pinned exact quest-location authority as RezervBase, avoiding a guessed map selector.
The operation intentionally pays no boss gear or trophy reward, avoiding a boss-equipment faucet.

economyReview.reason: One non-repeatable late-campaign boss disruption plus extraction justifies critical-band currency/XP, but no boss gear, guaranteed trophy or capability unlock is required.
